FULL TEXT:
I. T. Cell
High Court of Gujarat
Date: 04/07/2019
Subject: Online Filing of SICK NOTE & SMS Alert of Sick Note
to rest of the advocates of the matter
This is to inform all the Ld. Advocates that the facility of online filing
of Sick Note is already available at http://gujarathc-
casestatus.nic.in/gujarathc/ with icon name 'SICK LEAVE NOTE'. This
facility can be used by any advocates using his/her Advocate Code number
and the OTP received on his/her registered mobile with the I. T. Cell.
On recommendation of the Hon'ble ICT & eGovernance Committee
and approval of the Hon'ble the Acting Chief Justice, a new facility of
automatically sending SMS alert of Sick Note to the rest of the advocates of
the matters, is being implemented from 05-07-2019. Such an SMS alert
will also be sent for Sick Note filed physically at the Registry.
Registrar (SCMS & ICT)
